Moving recordings between folders and organizations is one clear step, and phone recordings no longer show every highlight at 00:00.

**One place to choose where a recording lives.** Moving a recording, filing it from the report, importing audio or a transcript, and the auto-share setting now all use the same sheet:

- Pick **Personal** or an organization at the top, then a folder (or no folder). New folders can be created right there.
- The sheet shows where the recording is now, and the button says exactly what will happen, e.g. "Move to Pathors › Client meetings".
- Moving into an organization says who will be able to see it. Tick **Keep a copy in Personal** to copy instead of move.
- The folder list scrolls again; it used to get stuck inside the sheet.

**Timing for recordings synced from the phone** (#576)

- Meetings the phone re-transcribed or imported arrived with every line at 0:00, so highlights, action items and transcript seeking all pointed at the start. Phones on the new versions send real times.
- Recordings that already synced without times now get estimated times from the audio length, marked as estimated in the transcript. Regenerate the analysis to re-anchor their highlights.
- The MCP tools (`get_recording`, `search_meetings`) return the same estimated times instead of [0:00].
